comment.text: HNMT L145 is represented as a recurrently mutated residue in Cancer Hotspots v1. Source observations include Hepatocellular carcinoma; Lung squamous cell carcinoma; Gastric adenocarcinoma; Endometrial carcinoma. Statistical enrichment supports review as a candidate somatic hotspot; it does not establish the functional effect, pathogenicity, or treatment sensitivity of every alteration at this position. This site is present only in the historical V1 material in this collection.

applicability_notes: Confirm the exact allele and reference transcript: source protein numbering is not a validated clinical HGVS assertion.
Tumor counts describe source cohorts and may overlap between releases and sheets; they must not be added together.
An observed synonymous or stop allele is retained for source fidelity and is not automatically classified as oncogenic.
FDA references are separate gene-level evidence until the exact biomarker, tumor, setting, and current label have been checked.

report_comment.text: Somatic alterations affecting HNMT residue L145 have been observed in hepatocellular carcinoma, endometrial carcinoma, and lung squamous cell carcinoma. The functional and clinical significance depend on the specific alteration and tumor type.

comment.text: HNMT L145L is an allele annotation observed in Cancer Hotspots v1 at the L145 hotspot or indel region. This documents recurrence in the source cohorts; allele-specific function, tumor-specific significance, reference-sequence mapping, and clinical actionability require independent review.
